description: Client-side Minecraft mod where mobs and players become real physics ragdolls that react to how they died. Minecraft 1.21 to 26.3, on Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge and Forge.

releases.notes:
### New
- **Riders are physics bodies.** A rider that dies on a living mount (a skeleton horseman, a spider or chicken jockey, a pillager on a ravager, a player on a horse) leaves its seat with the mount's momentum, pushed away from the blow, and tumbles to the ground, instead of playing the 1.0 animation.
- **Mannequins** get a body like a player's instead of the vanilla death.
- **Armor and held items burn in lava.** Armor, horse and wolf armor and llama carpets burn black exactly where they were under the lava, like the skin under them. A held item burns black once the hand holding it goes in. Netherite and anything else that does not burn in lava keeps its look.
- **Push Dead Bodies** (setting, on by default). A player or living mob that walks into a physics body pushes it along. Only you see it move, and the body never pushes back, so moving stays exactly as in vanilla.
- **Blood (Beta)** (setting, off by default). A spray of blood from where the killing blow struck, a few drops while the body is fresh, and a splatter on a hard landing. Bones, golems, slimes, blazes, breezes, shulkers, allays, vexes and mannequins never bleed, and nothing bleeds in lava.

### Fixed
- **Bodies above the build limit did not fall.** A mob or player that died at y 320 or higher froze where it died, shook for a second and vanished, instead of falling: the game counts those heights as never loaded, and the body was let go on its first tick. Now only whether the chunk under the body is loaded counts.
- On NeoForge 26.2 and 26.3 a warning came up at startup about the mod's icon (NeoForge renamed the setting for it).

### Changed
- **One Body Lifetime.** Body Lifetime and Physics Body Lifetime are now one setting, Body Lifetime (5 seconds by default, 1 to 60), in the General section. It sets how long a body stays with Physics Bodies on or off; with Physics Bodies off, the death animations play out as before and the body then lies there for the rest of its lifetime. The old `lifetimeTicks` in the settings file is no longer read.
- **A Beta section** in the settings, after Physics, holds Knees and Elbows and Blood.
- **Death Camera is on by default.**
- A player whose skin cannot be burnt pixel by pixel is still drawn burnt black, but their armor and held items now burn (or not) on their own instead of all going dark.

releases.notes:
- **Death Camera Distance and Death Camera Circling.** Two new settings: how far the death camera stays from your body (1.5 to 10 blocks), and whether it circles it or holds the angle it started from.
- **Translations.** The settings screen is now also in Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Russian and Simplified Chinese.
- Fixed: on 1.21 and 1.21.1, living mobs looked bent and twisted after one of their kind died ([#3](https://github.com/Frostfleee/Ragdoll-Deaths/issues/3)).
- Fixed: resource packs made for Entity Model Features (Fresh Animations and other "3D mobs" packs) broke the bodies.
- Fixed: a body thrown or carried about 70 blocks from where its mob died turned invisible.

releases.notes:
- **Minecraft 1.21 to 1.21.11.** Every loader now also runs on 1.21 to 1.21.11, with the same physics bodies.
- **Death camera follows your body.** While you are dead, the view follows your own body's head and slowly circles it, keeping out of walls.
- **Player Body Until Respawn.** A new setting, on by default: a player's body stays until they respawn.

![The death camera following your body, which stays until you respawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1eTrUOwY/images/7223d04675607fa8f82eefbea9fdbf4110129b65.gif)

- **Shulkers are physics bodies.** The killing blow knocks the shell over and it tumbles as the full box it is; when its time is up it breaks like a shulker box of its color, with the box's breaking sound.
- Fixed: your own body was thrown about three times too far by the killing blow.
- Fixed: your own body could vanish a moment after you died.
- Fixed: the Quilt jars did not load on Quilt.
- Fixed: on Forge, a loading-error screen at startup, and the settings text missing.

releases.notes:
Dead mobs are now real physics bodies instead of playing a fixed animation.

- **Physics bodies.** A dying mob becomes rigid parts joined at its joints. It falls, tumbles, slides and comes to rest on whatever blocks are there: stairs, slabs, fences, walls. Armor and held items follow.
- **The killing blow matters.** Melee hits knock the body back; Knockback, sprint hits and Punch throw it further. Arrows hit the part they pass through. Creepers and TNT fling bodies away and walls block the blast. A mace smash drives the body down.
- **Dying muscles.** For about a second and a half the body braces and reaches, then goes limp.
- **Water and lava.** Bodies float and drift with the current; soul sand bubble columns lift them fast, magma ones slowly. Lava burns black exactly the pixels that touched it.
- **Materials.** Bodies slide far on ice, bounce on slime, hang in cobwebs and sink into powder snow.
- **Special mobs.** Skeletons break apart, a snow golem's pumpkin rolls off, blaze and breeze rods drop free, spiders flip and curl.
- **Sounds and dust.** Thuds, splashes and bone clatter, heard only by you.
- **Settings.** A new Physics section; turning Physics Bodies off brings back the 1.0 animations.
- Fixed: on 26.1.x a render hook did not apply, so limb and armor posing could fail.
